title: Climbing Kilimanjaro and Safari Comb
content:
This 15-day adventure combines a thrilling Kilimanjaro climb with an unforgettable safari experience, perfectly suited for those seeking both the challenge of summiting Africa’s highest peak and the wonder of Tanzania’s most iconic wildlife. The trek begins with a scenic transfer to your hotel in Moshi, followed by a pre-trekking briefing to prepare for the climb.

Over the next few days, you’ll ascend through lush rainforests and alpine deserts, reaching the summit of Mount Kilimanjaro, Uhuru Peak, on Day 6. After descending, you’ll be ready for the next phase of your adventure—a safari. For the best experience, we recommend scheduling your safari between June and October, as this period aligns with the spectacular Great Migration in the Serengeti.

On safari, you’ll explore Tarangire National Park, where you’ll witness wildlife congregating around water sources, before experiencing the cultural richness of Lake Eyasi with the Hadzabe and Datoga tribes. Your journey continues to the Serengeti, where the migration spectacle unfolds across the plains. Witness massive herds of wildebeests and zebras crossing the Mara River, a breathtaking sight.

The final part of your safari takes you to the Ngorongoro Crater, home to an abundance of wildlife in one of the world’s most unique ecosystems. Whether you’re trekking to the top of Kilimanjaro or exploring the vast landscapes of Tanzania, this adventure promises an unparalleled combination of natural beauty and cultural immersion.

Where you stay

At Salinero Hotels we do not believe in numbers but we do believe in a service keeping our few customers happy around the clock. Salinero Kilimanjaro is Located 3 Km from Moshi town center in the Leafy suburb of shanty town.

The hotel now blends in simplistic elegance with perfect architectural designs all combined to entice even the most seasoned traveller. Now operating as a 30-room unit, we ensure that clients enjoy personalized service around the clock whilst staying with us. Our well manicured gardens provide the ample settings for your wedding reception or any other special event that you may have.

Endoro Lodge is an Eco friendly safari lodge located on the slops of Ngorongoro highland forest. We have beautiful chalet rooms which are uniquely designed to give our clients an authentic African experience. Our highly skilled stuff uphold the slogan which is integrate with nature for they are all dressed in authentic Masai cloths.

Serengeti Ikoma Wild camp is located in the buffer zone of Serengeti Ecosystem between Grumeti and the Ikorongo Game reserve, Northwest of Serengeti. Our comfortable permanent camp consists of 10 huts/Boma and 15 spacious tents, well furnished with an ensuite bathroom.

Ikoma Wild camps gives you the opportunity to enjoy the stunning view over the surrounding Savannah, which is full of wildlife during the whole year. The unique and comfortable Camps offers Various contemporary amenities such as Dining & Bar Activities, internet, Sundowner cocktails to Bush meals at a private site, Serengeti Ikoma Multi-cuisine restaurant provide a memorable dining and Wildlife experience

short_desc: This 15-day adventure combines a thrilling Kilimanjaro climb with an unforgettable safari experience, perfectly suited for those seeking both the challenge of summiting Africa’s highest peak and the wonder of Tanzania’s most iconic wildlife
address: Marangu Gate, Mandara Hut, Horombo Hut

faqs.title: What is included in the Tanzania Combo Package?
faqs.content: Our Tanzania Combo Packages include a combination of a Mount Kilimanjaro climb, a thrilling safari experience, and a relaxing stay in Zanzibar. We provide expert guides, park fees, accommodation, meals, and transportation for the entire trip, so you can focus on enjoying your adventure. You can customize your itinerary based on your preferences.

faqs.title: How long does the combo trip last?
faqs.content: The length of the combo trip varies depending on the itinerary you choose. Typically, the Kilimanjaro climb takes 6 to 8 days, followed by 3 to 4 days on safari in top parks like Serengeti and Ngorongoro Crater, and 4 to 5 days in Zanzibar. The total trip can range from 10 to 14 days, depending on your preferences.

faqs.title: Do I need any prior experience for climbing Mount Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: No prior climbing experience is required. However, you should be in good physical condition to handle the altitude and trekking. Our guides will support you throughout the climb, and we recommend some fitness training before your trip. The right preparation will help ensure a safe and enjoyable climb.

faqs.title: What are the best months to visit Tanzania for the combo package?
faqs.content: The best time to visit Tanzania for a combo trip is during the dry seasons, typically from June to October and December to February. These months offer ideal weather for both climbing Mount Kilimanjaro and going on safari, as wildlife is easier to spot, and the conditions are favorable for trekking.

faqs.title: Can I customize my safari experience within the combo package?
faqs.content: Yes! Our combo packages are flexible, and you can customize your safari experience based on your interests. Whether you want to focus on seeing the Big Five, experiencing the Great Migration, or enjoying a private safari with a personal guide, we can tailor the safari to your preferences.

faqs.title: What type of accommodation can I expect during the combo trip?
faqs.content: We offer a variety of accommodation options based on your comfort preferences. For the Kilimanjaro trek, you’ll stay in mountain huts or camping facilities. On safari, you can enjoy luxury lodges and tented camps, depending on your choice. In Zanzibar, we provide a range of options from beachfront resorts to boutique hotels, ensuring a comfortable and relaxing stay.

itinerary.title: Day 1
itinerary.content:
As you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our dedicated driver will be there to warmly greet you, holding a sign with your name for a personal touch. You will then enjoy a seamless transfer to the enchanting to your Hotel, where a delicious meal awaits you. Following this, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will conduct a pre-trekking briefing, giving you valuable insights into the wonders that lie ahead during your expedition.

Take the time to unwind and enjoy the relaxing environment of your Hotel, which features a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, a bar, and a restaurant. This setting provides the perfect opportunity to prepare for your upcoming adventure while ensuring your comfort and relaxation before you begin your trek.

Overnight: Sal salinero hotel or similar

itinerary.title: Day 2
itinerary.desc: Moshi to Marangu Gate | Mandara Hut
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 1,830 meters (6,004 feet) – 2,700 meters (8,858 feet)
  • Hiking distance: 8 km
  • Hiking time: 4 to 5 hours

After breakfast, your adventure begins with a 1-hour drive from Moshi to the Marangu Gate, where you’ll complete the necessary registration formalities. Once the paperwork is done, you’ll embark on your trek through the lush rainforest. The trail to Mandara Hut, your first camp, involves a steady uphill hike, providing opportunities to spot playful monkeys and various wildlife along the way.

Upon reaching Mandara, you’ll be welcomed with a warm meal and settle into comfortable A-frame huts for the night. In the evening, you can opt for a short acclimatization hike to Maundi Crater, where you can enjoy stunning panoramic views of the surrounding landscape. This hike not only aids in acclimatization but also allows you to soak in the beauty of your surroundings before continuing your trek .

itinerary.title: Day 3
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 2,700 meters (8,858 feet) – 3,720 meters (12,205 feet)
  • Hiking distance: 12 km
  • Hiking time: 5 to 6 hours

Begin your day with a hearty breakfast at Mandara Hut, fueling up for the exciting trek ahead. As you continue your journey, you’ll traverse through the lush rainforest before transitioning into the moorland zone. The ascent showcases a gradual change in vegetation, giving way to a more rugged and open landscape. This 6-hour trek to Horombo Hut offers stunning views of both Kibo and Mawenzi peaks, making it a memorable leg of your adventure.

Upon arrival at Horombo Hut, you’ll be greeted with a warm meal, giving you the chance to relax and acclimate to the higher altitude. In the evening, your guide will provide a comprehensive briefing about the next day’s trek, ensuring that you’re well-prepared for the challenges ahead. This preparation is key to successfully navigating the upcoming stages of your climb.

itinerary.title: Day 4
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,720 meters (12,205 feet)

To assist with acclimatization, you’ll spend an extra day at Horombo Hut, allowing your body more time to adjust to the increasing altitude. This crucial acclimatization day provides the option to either relax at the camp or embark on a short hike to Zebra Rocks, a striking geological feature situated at 3,980 meters above sea level. This acclimatization hike is designed to help your body better cope with the upcoming higher elevations, significantly reducing the risk of altitude sickness.

After your hike, you’ll return to camp for a hearty meal, providing you with the energy needed for the next stages of your journey. In the evening, you’ll have the opportunity to discuss the plans for the next day’s ascent with your guide, ensuring that you’re fully prepared for the challenges ahead. This day is essential for enhancing your chances of a successful summit attempt by allowing your body to acclimatize properly.

itinerary.title: Day 5
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,960 m – 4,035 m
  • Hiking distance: 10 km
  • Hiking time: 5 to 6 hours

Today’s trek takes you across the expansive lunar desert known as the Saddle, a rugged and barren landscape stretching between the Kibo and Mawenzi peaks. Although the terrain may seem stark and desolate, the awe-inspiring views of the towering peaks on either side are a highlight of this journey. The hike typically takes around 6 hours, allowing plenty of time to soak in the vastness of the landscape and appreciate the unique beauty of this high-altitude environment.

Upon reaching Kibo Hut, you’ll settle in for an early dinner and some much-needed rest, conserving your energy for the upcoming summit attempt. In the evening, your guide will provide a detailed briefing to prepare you for the final ascent, which will begin just before midnight. This briefing is essential, as it covers the route, safety measures, and what to expect during the challenging climb ahead. Proper preparation and rest are crucial for a successful summit bid.

itinerary.title: Day 6
itinerary.desc: Kibo Hut | Summit Attempt | Horombo Hut
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 4,700 meters (15,419 feet) – 5,895 meters (19,341 feet) – 3,720 meters (12,205 feet)
  • Hiking distance: 22 km
  • Hiking & descending time: 12 to 15 hours

Around midnight, you’ll be awakened to begin the final ascent toward Uhuru Peak. The journey to Gillman’s Point at 5,685 meters is steep and strenuous, typically taking around six hours of steady climbing. This challenging section will test your endurance, but your guide will offer support and encouragement along the way.

Once you reach Gillman’s Point, you’ll traverse the crater rim toward Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa. If the weather cooperates, you’ll be rewarded with a breathtaking sunrise over the continent, a truly unforgettable sight. After celebrating your incredible achievement at the summit, you’ll descend back to Kibo Hut for a short rest before continuing onward to Horombo Hut for the night, allowing your body to recover after the exhilarating challenge.

itinerary.title: Day 7
itinerary.desc: Horombo Hut to Marangu Gate | Return to Moshi
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,720 meters (12,205 feet) – 1,830 meters (6,004 feet)
  • Hiking distance: 20 km
  • Hiking time: 6 to 7 hours

After breakfast, you’ll start your descent through the diverse moorland and lush rainforest zones, making your way back to Marangu Gate. As you trek downward, take in the final views of the landscape and reflect on your accomplishment. Upon reaching the gate, you’ll be presented with your well-earned summit certificate as a testament to your achievement.

From there, you’ll be driven back to your Hotel in Moshi, where a hot meal, a refreshing shower, and a comfortable bed await you. As this is a combo package, you will receive a pre-safari briefing in the late afternoon. Our safari coordinator will meet with you at the hotel to provide detailed information about your upcoming safari adventure and answer any questions you may have. This briefing will ensure you’re fully prepared for the exciting experiences ahead!

itinerary.title: Day 8
itinerary.content:
Begin your day with breakfast before setting out on a drive to Tarangire National Park, a prime destination for exceptional wildlife viewing. Known for its vibrant animal populations, especially in the dry season, Tarangire attracts vast herds gathering around its life-sustaining river.

The park’s varied scenery—ranging from lush savannahs and swamps to rugged hills and towering baobabs—offers an impressive backdrop to observe elephants, zebras, buffalo, and sometimes lions and oryx as they roam in search of water.

Bird enthusiasts will appreciate the abundant birdlife, while the Tarangire River remains a crucial water source throughout the dry months. After this immersive day of safari exploration, unwind overnight at Endoro Lodge or a similar accommodation, preparing for more adventures ahead.

Overnight: Endoro Lodge or similar

itinerary.title: Day 9
itinerary.content:
Start your day with a scenic drive to the shores of Lake Eyasi, a remote and tranquil area that offers a unique cultural and scenic experience. Upon arrival, immerse yourself in the fascinating traditions of the Hadzabe and Datoga communities. The Hadzabe, one of the last remaining hunter-gatherer tribes in East Africa, will share their way of life with you through interactive activities like learning their hunting techniques, using traditional bows and arrows, and discovering how they gather food from the surrounding wilderness. This rare opportunity provides deep insight into a lifestyle that has remained unchanged for centuries.

Next, visit the Datoga people, skilled pastoralists and blacksmiths, who will showcase their metalworking skills, including crafting tools and ornaments from recycled materials. Their rich traditions and hospitality will leave a lasting impression. After engaging with these vibrant cultures, enjoy the stunning views of Lake Eyasi’s tranquil waters and surrounding landscapes, a serene contrast to the bustling wildlife safaris. Conclude your day with a relaxing evening at Endoro Lodge or a similar lodge, reflecting on the unique cultural encounters and natural beauty you’ve experienced.

Overnight: Endoro Lodge or similar

itinerary.title: Day 10
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, your safari guide will pick you up for a scenic drive to Serengeti, passing through the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Along the way, you’ll stop at Olduvai Gorge, a fascinating archaeological site known as the “Cradle of Mankind,” where you can learn about the history of early humans.

Upon entering Serengeti, you’ll be greeted by the sight of the Great Migration, where wildebeests, zebras, and gazelles roam across the plains. The park’s diverse landscapes are home to the Big Five and many other species. In the evening, you’ll arrive at Ikoma Wild Camp, where you can enjoy a thrilling night game drive, observing the Serengeti’s nocturnal wildlife in its natural habitat.

Overnight: Ikoma Wild Camp or similar

itinerary.title: Day 11
itinerary.desc: Witness the Great Migration at Mara River
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, you’ll head to the Mara River in the Northern Serengeti, where the incredible Great Migration unfolds. Watch in awe as massive herds of wildebeest and zebras cross the river in search of fresh grazing grounds. This dramatic event is a highlight of the Serengeti, and you may even spot crocodiles lying in wait or a variety of bird species in the area. After an unforgettable day witnessing one of nature’s most spectacular events, you’ll return to Ikoma Wild Camp for a relaxing evening. Enjoy a sundowner experience at the camp, sipping a drink as you watch the stunning Serengeti sunset.

Overnight: Ikoma Wild Camp or similar

itinerary.title: Day 12
itinerary.content:
Prepare for a full day of exploration in the Serengeti! After an early breakfast, embark on morning and afternoon game drives across the iconic savannas. The Serengeti offers unmatched opportunities for wildlife viewing, where you’ll have the chance to see large prides of lions, and leopards lounging in acacia trees, and herds of wildebeest and zebra roaming the plains.

Your guide will help you track the movements of different animals, potentially witnessing hunting scenes and interactions that reveal the complex dynamics of the Serengeti ecosystem. Enjoy a picnic lunch amid the park’s breathtaking landscapes, then continue your adventure until sunset. Return to your lodge for a restful evening under the Serengeti stars.

Overnight: Serengeti central lodge or similar

itinerary.title: Day 13
itinerary.desc: Morning Game Drive and Transfer to Ngorongoro
itinerary.content:
Start your day with a morning game drive in the Serengeti, making the most of the cooler hours when wildlife is most active. This is a great opportunity to spot predators like lions or cheetahs on the move and witness the beauty of the Serengeti one last time.

After the game drive, enjoy a scenic drive to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Upon arrival, settle into your accommodation at Ngorongoro Safari Lodge, Ngorongoro Wild Camp, or a similar lodge, where you can relax and prepare for the next day’s adventure.

Overnight: Ngorongoro Safari Lodge, Ngorongoro Wild Camp, or similar

itinerary.title: Day 14
itinerary.desc: Ngorongoro Crater Exploration and Transfer to Karatu
itinerary.content:
Start your day with an exciting journey into the Ngorongoro Crater, one of Africa’s most famous wildlife destinations and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Descend into this vast, natural caldera, often called the “Eighth Wonder of the World,” where you’ll experience a thriving ecosystem unlike any other. During your game drive, you’ll have the chance to see a diverse range of wildlife, including lions, elephants, rhinos, and large herds of wildebeest and zebras. Don’t miss the vibrant flocks of flamingos that gather along the shores of the crater’s central lake.

After a memorable day of wildlife encounters, you’ll head out of the crater and drive to the charming Karatu area. Here, you’ll settle in for a restful evening at Endoro Lodge or a similar lodge, surrounded by the serene beauty of the countryside. Relax and prepare for the next leg of your adventure.

Overnight: Endoro Lodge or similar

itinerary.title: Day 15
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, you’ll be transferred to Kilimanjaro International Airport, where your journey began, for your departure. Reflect on the incredible experiences and memories you’ve made during your adventure.

For those wishing to extend their trip, there are exciting options available. You can explore nearby attractions through one of the day trips featured on our Day Trip page, offering cultural, scenic, or adventurous activities. Alternatively, you can embark on a Zanzibar excursion, where you’ll enjoy pristine beaches, rich history, and vibrant culture.

If you choose the Zanzibar extension, we’ll arrange your transfer to Arusha Airport for your flight to Zanzibar on this same day. Visit our Zanzibar page to discover the perfect package for your next adventure.
